pi_interval.method: Machin formula pi = 16 atan(1/5) - 4 atan(1/239), each arctangent bounded by 10 alternating-series terms.

interval_method.split_policy: Every tube and complement is split at source basis breakpoints plus uniform rational subdivisions before derivative or sign tests.

limitations: Does not classify any null-coordinate preledger row as empty, simple_root, or fold_layer.
